welcome_page.title: Motorcycle and scooter – Comfort
welcome_page.description:
Parking, charging, delays and your surroundings when you ride a motorcycle or scooter.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: How good is motorcycle parking near the places you go?
questions.help: Think of spaces marked for motorcycles and places where your vehicle is safe from theft.

questions.text: How much do charging points affect whether you use your electric motorcycle or scooter?

options.text: Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric

questions.text: When you are held up on a motorcycle or scooter trip, how stressed do you feel?
questions.help: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or closed windows
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of on foot)

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stops or stretches
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

it.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: Com'è il parcheggio per le moto vicino ai posti dove vai?
it.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: Pensa agli stalli segnati per le moto e ai posti dove il tuo veicolo è al sicuro dai furti.
it.#How much do charging points affect whet: Quanto contano le colonnine di ricarica per usare la tua moto o il tuo scooter elettrico?
it.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: Non mi riguarda: il mio veicolo non è elettrico
it.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: Quando resti bloccato o in ritardo in uno spostamento in moto o in scooter, quanto stress senti?
it.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Per esempio code, scontri o lavori in corso.
it.#Your surroundings: Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Quando vai in moto o in scooter, quanto ti disturba o ti infastidisce il rumore del traffico?
Quando vai in moto o in scooter, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina o i finestrini chiusi
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che a piedi)
it.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Quando vai in moto o in scooter, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I prepare differently or change route (: Mi preparo in modo diverso o cambio percorso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)
it.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Quando vai in moto o in scooter, cosa fai quando strade, fermate o percorsi sono sporchi o mal tenuti (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Evito alcune fermate o alcuni tratti
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Quando vai in moto o in scooter, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o sgradevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale.
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Parking, charging, delays and your s:
Parcheggio, ricarica, ritardi e ambiente intorno a te quando vai in moto o in scooter.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: Comment est le stationnement pour motos près des endroits où vous allez ?
fr.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: Pensez aux places marquées pour les motos et aux endroits où votre véhicule est à l'abri du vol.
fr.#How much do charging points affect whet: Dans quelle mesure les bornes de recharge influencent-elles votre usage de votre moto ou scooter électrique ?
fr.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: Cela ne me concerne pas : mon véhicule n'est pas électrique
fr.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: Quand un retard vous ralentit lors d’un trajet à moto ou en scooter, quel stress ressentez-vous ?
fr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Par exemple des embouteillages, des collisions ou des travaux.
fr.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Lorsque vous roulez à moto ou en scooter, dans quelle mesure le bruit de la circulation vous dérange-t-il ?
Lorsque vous roulez à moto ou en scooter, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque ou en fermant les fenêtres
fr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Je prends un autre itinéraire ou je me déplace à un autre moment
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus plutôt qu'à pied)
fr.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Lorsque vous roulez à moto ou en scooter, que faites-vous habituellement quand le temps est mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou grande chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I prepare differently or change route (: Je me prépare autrement ou je change d'itinéraire (par ex. vêtements, parapluie)
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en bus)
fr.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Lorsque vous roulez à moto ou en scooter, que faites-vous quand les rues, les arrêts ou les chemins sont sales ou mal entretenus (déchets, odeurs, verre brisé) ?
fr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d'habitude
fr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: C'est désagréable, mais je passe quand même par là
fr.#I avoid some stops or stretches: J'évite certains arrêts ou certains tronçons
fr.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: Lorsque vous roulez à moto ou en scooter, un cadre agréable ou désagréable influence-t-il ce que vous ressentez ?
fr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Par exemple les bâtiments, les places, l'entretien d'un lieu et son atmosphère générale.
fr.#No, I don't pay attention to them: Non, je n'y fais pas attention
fr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Je les remarque, mais elles font rarement une différence
fr.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Elles influencent beaucoup ce que je ressens en chemin
fr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire parce qu'il est plus agréable ou plus intéressant
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Parking, charging, delays and your s:
Le stationnement, la recharge, les retards et votre environnement lorsque vous roulez à moto ou en scooter.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom. Indiquer votre adresse e-mail est facultatif ; les informations sur la protection des données de SmartUrbanity expliquent comment elle est protégée et comment vos réponses sont utilisées.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

Parken, Laden, Verzögerungen und Ihre Umgebung, wenn Sie Motorrad oder Roller fahren.

fa.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: پارکینگ موتورسیکلت نزدیک جاهایی که می‌روید چقدر خوب است؟
fa.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: به جاهای علامت‌گذاری‌شده برای موتورسیکلت و جاهایی فکر کنید که وسیله شما از دزدی در امان است.
fa.#How much do charging points affect whet: ایستگاه‌های شارژ چقدر بر استفاده شما از موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر برقی‌تان اثر می‌گذارند؟
fa.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: مربوط به من نیست: وسیله من برقی نیست
fa.#When you are held up on a motorcycle or: وقتی در سفر با موتورسیکلت یا اسکوتر معطل می‌شوید، چقدر احساس تنش می‌کنید؟
fa.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: مثلاً ترافیک سنگین، برخورد خودروها یا کار در جاده.
fa.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: هنگام موتورسواری، سروصدای ترافیک چقدر شما را اذیت یا آزرده می‌کند؟

fa.#Nothing, it doesn't affect me: هیچ کاری، بر من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: متوجه می‌شوم، اما چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: از خودم محافظت می‌کنم، مثلاً با ماسک یا بستن شیشه‌ها
fa.#I take another route or travel at anoth: مسیر دیگری می‌روم یا در زمان دیگری سفر می‌کنم
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با اتوبوس به جای پیاده)
fa.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: هنگام موتورسواری، وقتی هوا بد است (باران، باد، سرما یا گرمای شدید) معمولاً چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: چیزی تغییر نمی‌کند، مثل همیشه سفر می‌کنم
fa.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: کمتر دلپذیر است، اما به همان شکل سفر می‌کنم
fa.#I prepare differently or change route (: طور دیگری آماده می‌شوم یا مسیرم را عوض می‌کنم (مثلاً لباس، چتر)
fa.#I put off or skip some trips: بعضی سفرها را به تعویق می‌اندازم یا انجام نمی‌دهم
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با خودرو یا اتوبوس)
fa.#When you ride a motorcycle or scooter,: هنگام موتورسواری، وقتی خیابان‌ها، ایستگاه‌ها یا مسیرها کثیف یا نگهداری‌نشده‌اند (زباله، بوی بد، شیشه شکسته) چه می‌کنید؟
